sentence: keeps every square submatrix invertible for `k + m <= 256`

evidence: internal/storage/node.go:63 uses min(K+1,K+M). The chapter explicitly allows m=0; its stated default would then be outside its own valid range.

sentence: permanent damage (bit-rot, wipe) never makes a GET unavailable
evidence: internal/storage/node.go:297 acknowledges at quorum, not all n shards. internal/storage/dst_test.go:25 starts faults at 10 s after fault-free PUTs at 1 s. The separate claims_test.go counterexample has five durable shards after a successful 4+2 PUT, heals the network, then rots two shards; Budget.Check passes but GET is unavailable without ErrIO. Chapter 7 explicitly recognizes unwritten shards can drop a stripe below k.
fix: In this suite, after fault-free writes have settled, permanent damage within MaxDamagedPerGroup=m never made a GET unavailable. A quorum-only PUT does not yet guarantee m further losses can be tolerated.

sentence: Equal roots stop in one message

fix: Equal roots stop in one round trip.

sentence: Every Tier S failure prints a replay line:
evidence: test/e2e/e7_test.go:75 has parent-level aggregate sweep failures after child cleanup, without Report; internal/sim/simtest/determinism.go:41 registers reports on the individual seed test. Single-seed replay also cannot reproduce a sweep floor requiring >=10/20 seeds. README:71 repeats the broader guarantee.
fix: Failures in individual RequireDeterministic scenarios print a single-seed replay line; aggregate sweep checks require rerunning the original sweep.
